purpose: Test a new source-separated trade-to-economic edge using IMF IMTS world exports, not WDI trade openness
native_frequency: annual for both source and target

trade_state.definition: XG_FOB_USD reporter-to-G001 raw annual value at t is strictly lower than the immediately preceding exact source year t-1
trade_state.transformation_policy: No log, ratio, percent normalization, smoothing, imputation, or source averaging; only a sign rule over raw USD levels explicitly authorized by this contract

origin_years: 2001-2021; later origins excluded for h=2/3 when target future values are unavailable
metric: one-sided risk difference P(material_deterioration | export_contraction) - P(material_deterioration | no_contraction), max-statistic across horizons on confirmation

null.method: within-reporter permutation of target annual outcome labels with trade exposure fixed

minimum_coverage: At least 5 positive trade-state origins and 5 positive target outcomes on confirmation, otherwise not_testable
missing_data: complete-case per reporter and horizon; exact consecutive source years; no imputation
promotion: supported_predictive only if predeclared rule has positive confirmation risk difference and null p<0.05 with no material validation contradiction; otherwise rejected or not_testable
